No. EGC/2026/01
Date: 12 November 2026
Ethos Group of Companies Becomes the Core Public Beneficiary Company of the Continental Security Agency
Eight member companies across the United States of America, the Republic of Maldives and the United Arab Emirates now operate as CSA Public Bonds Companies.

The Ethos Group of Companies CPbc. LLC (the "Ethos Group") and its eight member companies have been placed under the jurisdiction of the CSA Public Companies Authority as Public Bonds Companies. The placement was made by President's Order Number 04/2026 (Placement of the Ethos Group of Companies LLC under the CSA Public Companies Authority), issued on 11 November 2026 under Article 22 (a) of Act Number 2/2026 (Public Bonds Companies Act).

With this placement, the Ethos Group becomes the core public beneficiary company of the Continental Security Agency. The Group falls under the Business Development industry and the sector of the Department of Economy and Trade.
What is new for the Ethos Group

President's Order Number 04/2026 (Placement of the Ethos Group of Companies LLC under the CSA Public Companies Authority) and President's Order Number 05/2026 (Appointment of the Boards of the Member Companies of the Ethos Group of Companies CPbc. LLC) bring the following changes.

items.text: The Group's name is changed from "Ethos Group of Companies LLC" to "Ethos Group of Companies CPbc. LLC".
Each of the eight member companies is now a Public Bonds Company. Each bears the CPbc. name, industry and sector department stated for it under Member Companies of the Ethos Group.

The Board of the Ethos Group is appointed by the President of the Continental Security Agency and is led by a Chairperson of the Group. Its directors are the Chief Executive Officers of the member companies and the other directors appointed to it.

The Boards of all eight member companies were appointed by President's Order Number 05/2026 (Appointment of the Boards of the Member Companies of the Ethos Group of Companies CPbc. LLC), issued on 12 November 2026. The Chairperson of the Group, the Managing Director and the Deputy Managing Director sit on the Board of every member company.
The Continental Security Agency holds 50% of the shares of the Ethos Group and of each of its member companies, and is their principal shareholder.

blocks.text: Member Companies of the Ethos Group
The Ethos Group has eight member companies: five incorporated in the State of California, United States of America, two in the Republic of Maldives and one in the United Arab Emirates.

blocks.text: International Member Companies
Three of the member companies are incorporated outside the United States of America: two in the Republic of Maldives and one in the United Arab Emirates.
Shareholding of the Ethos Group

The Ethos Group has a total share capital of USD 1,000,000,000, made up of 1,000,000 shares valued at USD 1,000 each. The Continental Security Agency holds 50% of these shares under point 5 of President's Order Number 04/2026 (Placement of the Ethos Group of Companies LLC under the CSA Public Companies Authority).

The Ethos Group distributes the remaining 500,000 shares under point 5 (d) of President's Order Number 04/2026 (Placement of the Ethos Group of Companies LLC under the CSA Public Companies Authority). The shares allocated to member companies are weighted by need, with priority given to Ethos Education Corporation CPbc.

10% of the shares of every member company of the Ethos Group are allocated to the public. These shares are available for purchase at an annual meeting held by the Board of the respective member company. The value of a share differs from one member company to another.
Ethos Group in Numbers
The Ethos Group employs 38,400 people across eight member companies, led by 68 board personnel who hold 100 board seats.
